summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing an operational treasury update, not a special situation. The company reported that between September 21 and September 25, 2026 it grew its SOL and SOL equivalents by 47,706 tokens, rising from 2,490,304 on September 18 to 2,538,010 on September 25, a 2% increase. Management stated the SOL is expected to be deployed through staking, validator and on-chain treasury infrastructure, subject to market conditions. A press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors or structural mechanics to assess; no risk-arb angle applies.
